blocks.x: Fraud and error capture up 26% — cross-source analytics with investigator case packs

A national tax administration: a Public Sector & Government program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Achala IT Solutions team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Fraud/error hid in agency seams; detection rules stale.
Investigators received raw referrals without evidence context. Legacy estate faced state-grade threats with manual accreditation evidence.

The fraud hub scores cross-source anomalies into investigator case packs with evidence bundles and provenance; Swarm agents assemble audit files; and the zero-trust program reduced the accreditation burden through continuous evidence mapped to national schemes.
